# Version 4.147.0
> **Skia m147 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.147.0-preview)

> **Superseded by [4.148.0](4.148.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 4.148.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.147.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.147 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and expanded platform support. The v4 preview line adds color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, zero-copy stream access, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. It also changes several preview APIs and raises the WebAssembly native-asset floor to .NET 8, so review the migration notes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Assembly version advances to 4.x** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks that require the previous assembly version. ([#3640](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3640), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed** — The Tizen arm and x86 native packages are no longer produced after upstream toolchain requirements made those EOL targets unusable. Move Tizen deployments to the new tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 assets. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8** — Native assets for Emscripten versions associated with .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed, and those target frameworks now produce a build error. Upgrade Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion type uses GR casing** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Replace direct uses of GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo; its legacy equality members are no longer part of the primary API. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKStream.Move rejects out-of-range offsets** — The obsolete SKStream.Move(long) overload now throws OverflowException when the offset does not fit in the native 32-bit value instead of truncating it. Use an in-range offset and migrate to the int-based API. ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m119 to m147** — The bundled engine gains newer image orientation, HDR, wide-gamut, color filter, drop-shadow, raster, and codec behavior across the m132, m133, and m147 updates. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Bundled image and font dependencies refreshed** — Updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, and libjpeg-turbo to newer upstream releases. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, design positions, named instances, palette selection, and per-color overrides for variable and color fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences with durations into animated WebP output using span-based overloads. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Configurable sampling for surface draws** — New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions for explicit mipmap and filter selection. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Zero-copy access to memory-backed streams** — SKStream.GetData() returns ref-counted SKData when the native stream can expose its backing data directly. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **New color, document, GPU, and filter APIs** — Adds CICP color-space creation, HDR color types, R16Unorm, SKDocumentXpsOptions, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, and the HBColor value type. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Default typeface resolution no longer crashes during Android startup** — Default font lookup now uses the managed font manager path and falls back to an empty typeface when no system font is available. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **SKPath finalization is safe when its builder is collected first** — Disposal no longer flushes a finalized SKPathBuilder, preventing a finalizer-thread native crash. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Android SKGLView survives MAUI tab switches** — Reattached GL views retain their dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface and rendering blank. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Variable-font span and glyph checks corrected** — Undersized variation buffers now report and copy the correct values, while SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses until a stack overflow. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **NanoServer initializes without a font subsystem** — Windows NanoServer now uses an empty font manager instead of crashing during the first SkiaSharp typeface initialization. ([#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic native assets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now ship linux-bionic assets for x64 and arm64 Android-hosted Linux environments. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **64-bit Tizen support** — Adds native packages for the official tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 runtime identifiers. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple library target frameworks use the base 26.0 workload** — Apple NuGet libraries target version 26.0 instead of 26.2, avoiding an unnecessary requirement for the newest point-version workload. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6

HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font shaping APIs, color font palette queries, and the HBColor value type, together with Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Raises the WebAssembly native-asset floor to .NET 8 and adopts GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, while adding HBColor, XPS document creation, resource-specific GPU flushes, and shader mask filters. It also fixes NanoServer font initialization and refreshes libjpeg-turbo, FreeType, and zlib. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001), [#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720))

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Begins the v4 preview line with Skia m147, variable fonts, color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, CICP color spaces, and Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. It removes 32-bit Tizen assets, advances the assembly version to 4.x, makes out-of-range SKStream.Move(long) calls throw, refreshes libexpat and libpng, and fixes Android default typeface startup and SKGLView tab reattachment.
